name: manosabamod-macos-frida
description: manosaba macOS MOD loader (Frida) — 多文件 ES modules 工程, frida-compile 打包单 bundle

scripts.check: node tools/check-imports.mjs && node tools/catch-audit.mjs && node test-tools/swallow-test.mjs && node tools/check-privacy.mjs
scripts.build: npm run check && frida-compile src/entry.js -o dist/manosabamod.js -S
